personal.name: Damián Andrés Clancig
personal.title: Senior FullStack Developer
personal.summary:
I am a Full Stack developer with over 15 years of experience, specializing in Java since 2007. I am passionate about software development, problem-solving, and continuous learning.

I am currently honing my skills in the JavaScript ecosystem, working with React.js for the frontend and Node.js with Express for the backend. I am also exploring Next.js to build more complete, fast, and optimized web applications. This evolution allows me to integrate both the traditional Java world and modern technologies geared towards dynamic web applications.

My professional goal is to join a 100% remote development team where I can contribute my experience, adaptability, and results-oriented approach, while continuing to grow technically in a collaborative environment.
